sloka: तेन तत्र महारण्ये मृगयां परिधावता ।राक्षसा निहताः शूरा बहवः कामरूपिणः ।। ५.३१.९।।।।
transliteration: tena tatra mahāraṇye mṛgayāṁ paridhāvatā ।rākṣasā nihatāḥ śūrā bahavaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।। 5.31.9।।।।

translations.english: "In the deep forest he went round hunting animals and killing the demon warriors who assumed any form at their free will.
